gemini_explanation_text: The Heat-Safe & Carbon-Aware schedule has been optimized across all 192 slots. By mathematically enforcing ISO 7243:2017 Table A.1 thermal thresholds, manual Class 3 furnace operations were shifted into cool morning hours, eliminating all 4 baseline heat breaches. Simultaneously, interruptible chiller and automated oven loads were shifted into the 10:00–16:00 solar window, capturing the 20% TGSPDCL tariff concession (Clause 4.2b) and yielding ₹16,420.00 in electricity bill savings while maintaining 98.6% throughput. 2 dedicated Heat Buffers were reserved to absorb worker rests without line stoppages. Note on emissions: Time-shifting saves rupees, not CO2, at an annual average grid factor.
